news.title: Haywire Announce Extensive 2027 World Tour
news.description: Haywire have announced an extensive world tour encompassing the UK, EU, US, and Canada in support of their album I DON'T WANNA SAY GOODBYE.

news.title: PHED sounds early alarm, drafts summer water crisis plan before Diwali
news.description: PHED drafts early summer water crisis plan for Rajasthan ahead of Diwali, seeking division-wise inputs and expanding groundwater use to support Bisalpur supply.

news.title: Raj braces for water crisis, CM to launch conservation drive
news.description: Rajasthan CM Bhajan Lal Sharma to launch statewide water conservation drive amid worsening crisis; focus on groundwater recharge, water bodies, and crackdown on tanker mafia.
